title: 澆
teacherNotes: Production A complete-package handoff for L306 澆. Use approved sentences exactly. Latest origin/main must be verified before release. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, and Stage 4 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate. Use natural Taiwan Mandarin for 澆水 and 澆花; do not use unnatural 澆樹 or unlearned display characters such as 熄, 壺, 照, 顧.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: latest origin/main learned chars through production JSON L300 + provisional learned chars [蟲, 條, 泥, 土, 種] + current new char 澆
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, labels, logos, brands, subtitles, readable marks, or watermarks anywhere.
Insects must be cute, gentle, sparse, and preschool-appropriate; no gross close-ups, no horror, no dense swarms, no realistic frightening details.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 澆 as public/assets/lessons/L306/audio/char-u6f86.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸買了一包泥土回家，準備和主角小女孩一起種花。畫面可有泥土包、花盆、小花，但圖片中不可有任何文字、數字、品牌或標籤。重點是爸爸買泥土回家種花。
主角小女孩拿著沒有文字或標籤的澆水容器，正在幫主角媽媽種的花澆水，主角媽媽在旁邊看著。畫面要清楚呈現給花澆水；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
主角爸爸在戶外或花盆旁，把水澆在土上，像是在種花前先讓土變濕。主角小女孩可在旁邊看。畫面要清楚呈現把水澆在土上；不可有文字、數字、標籤。

approvedSentences.text: 一條小蟲從泥土裡爬出來。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 一條小蟲從泥土裡爬出來
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 一條可愛小蟲從泥土裡爬出來，畫面像自然觀察場景，泥土和小蟲清楚可見。蟲要溫和可愛，不要噁心、不要密集蟲群，不可有文字、數字、標籤。
戶外正在下雨，花盆或花圃裡的小花被雨水澆到，主角小女孩站在門口或窗邊看著，不需要再澆花。畫面要清楚呈現下雨所以不用澆花；不可有文字、數字、標籤。
